0.0: Perion's gotten #bcolder and colder#k since the Black Mage took over Maple World.
0.1: I can't even sleep most nights. You think you could get me some #bfirewood#k?

yes.0: All I ask for is a dreamless sleep. Dreams wear me out. Even the pleasant ones, about the good old days.

item.0: I need more than #ra few#k. We've got a lot of cold folks around here. About #b25 pieces of Giant Firewood#k should do it.
